- To activate the energies of the 5 Mukhi Rudraksha, chant the following mantras 108 times during the wearing process:
- ॐ ह्रीं नमः (Om Hreem Namah)
- ॐ नमः शिवाय (Om Namah Shivaya)
- These mantras connect with the divine energy of Lord Kalagni Rudra and Jupiter.

sections.heading: Health Benefits
sections.content: The 5 Mukhi Rudraksha improves immunity, reduces blood pressure, and calms the nervous system. It is highly effective for stress relief, mental peace, and maintaining physical health.

- Quality: 100% Authentic

sections.heading: Method of Wearing
sections.content:
- Wake up early on a Thursday morning, preferably during Brahma Muhurta.
- Take a bath and cleanse yourself.
- Place the 5 Mukhi Rudraksha in a clean puja area.
- Offer water, flowers, and incense to the Rudraksha.
- Chant the mantras "Om Hreem Namah" and "Om Namah Shivaya" 108 times.
- Wear the Rudraksha in a silk or cotton thread, or have it encased in gold or silver.

sections.heading: About Career Growth and Obstacle Removal - Ganesh Rudraksha
sections.content: The Ganesh Rudraksha, symbolizing Lord Ganesha, is perfect for career growth and obstacle removal. It brings success, wisdom, and divine blessings, helping individuals overcome professional challenges and achieve their goals.

sections.heading: Mantra to Wear

- These mantras connect with the divine energy of Lord Ganesha.

sections.heading: Health Benefits
sections.content: The Ganesh Rudraksha reduces stress, enhances mental clarity, and boosts confidence. It supports emotional stability and physical energy, aiding in overcoming career-related pressures.

sections.heading: About Husband-Wife Disputes and Marriage Issues - Gauri Shankar Rudraksha

sections.heading: Health Benefits
